claim: A choice question reads its keys, not their descriptions: whatever the planner should weigh about a card must be in the key.
evidence: Replays unchanged when note only in description.

claim: The decision models judge one concrete option at a time better than they rank many at once.
evidence: E60: single-sentence planner.goal shifted elite from ~35% to winning goal at 1:59 when state directive did not name elites (contrast E54 failure on YLS7TB).

claim: Words beat numbers: describing a move's cost as 'Tibo would get badly hurt' picks the least damaging move far more often than a percentage.
evidence: Laya replay tests.

claim: A danger rating tracks how many threats a description lists, not which ones.
evidence: Hot oil example.

claim: A 0-4 hurt score per move finds the least damaging move more reliably than a yes/no danger question.
evidence: Jev replay 98-100%.

claim: The decision models weigh the start of a text most: what matters goes first.
evidence: E44 opening rules first: 118 explore vs 2 spot goals on 18-01-48; whetstone ban worked when listed (7:43).

claim: On the Nightmare Daily, crowds barely hurt a Tibo that keeps moving; nearly all damage comes from hot oil and bosses.
evidence: Daily E1.

claim: With no directive, the planner evades through the early minute and then collects gems.
The default pick question favours upgrading held cards; Reroll and Skip are rare early but Skip wins at high level on long runs.
evidence: 17-20-20 Skip at high hp. 18-01-48 many late Skips in picks section (10:32+ rerolls/skips) with five evolutions by 11:13 Railfry.

claim: Health rises with no food goal on the row; source not in log.
evidence: Long runs ~1000+ hp gained. 18-01-48 gained ~1363.

claim: A finished food goal heals about 30 hp unless boss hit in same seconds.
Compost Titan and Ketchup Kraken hit from afar outside one-second forecast.
evidence: Daily E1.

claim: At extraDamage 0.02, stepping off a charging chest can fail the goal when forecast punishes standing still.
evidence: Multiple runs with step-off failures and successes. 19-00-59 XEPS03: on the Golden Spud Shrine at 1:28, stand-still forecast -4 hp and the model walked off a channel at 3.9 of 5 seconds. The blessing still completed at 1:33.

claim: Evading every boss can be cheap on some daily seeds.
evidence: Daily E1.

claim: Trash inside 60 units and forecast misses both matter on world; which dominates is seed-dependent.
evidence: 17-44 contact death vs 17-20 page-walk ice-imp. 18-01-48 blight-spore 617 + boss lines. 18-32-36: forecast-free walks were 15 of 106 hp; hot oil, amusing and contact pests on model steps were the rest, on a 2:23 death. 18-47-09 YLS7TB: pests 82 (cave-grub 32, blight-spore 21, field-rat 10, compost-maggot 7, frost-flea 7, potato-beetle 5), amusing 54, Spore vent 18. Both still matter. 19-00-59 XEPS03: pests 113 of 119 (garden-slug 32, tomato-leech 21, sand-crab 18, ketchup-drop 14, oil-drip 12, bog-slime 9, fry-fly 7), amusing 6, queen absent from the outcome. Pests dominated this seed.

claim: With no directive on world, planner evades and gems lose.
Forecast-free steps still lose hp on world, especially bosses and crowds.
evidence: E20; long-run blight-spore on 18-01-48. 18-32-36: eight free walks, 15 hp (aphid, ketchup-drop, bog-slime, hot oil, amusing) even with distrustSeconds 8, which only starts after the hit. 18-47-09: the page walked through 10 hits with distrustSeconds 0, including the 2:43 chest step (16 to 5) with amusing 25 away. 19-00-59 XEPS03: the page walked through 18 hits with distrustSeconds 0. The death at 3:45 was on model steps, garden-slug and oil-drip in the last 3 seconds.

claim: No unexplained ~30 hp heal in world first three minutes.
Spud Freezer freeze line matches enemies_near drop.
Amusing ~2:00 and Colorado Queen ~3:00 on world; outcome lines vary by seed.
evidence: 18-01-48 amusing 2:00, queen 3:00; amusing 26 dmg in outcome. 18-32-36 IXJBKS: amusing at 2:00, 28 damage, run ended before queen. 18-47-09 YLS7TB: amusing at 2:00, 54 damage, died at 2:43 before the queen. 19-00-59 XEPS03: amusing at 2:00 for 6 damage, Colorado Queen at 3:02 with no queen line on the outcome.

claim: A plain directive in planner.state moves goal votes: chest, food, explore ban on early spots.
evidence: E44: 2 spot goals, 30 chests, 5 food on 18-01-48. 18-32-36: 0 spot goals across the whole run, including a nest at 34%. Whetstone, food under 70%, and a chest on the boss did not win. 18-47-09 had no nest ban: 6 Beetle Nest goals, all completed, and a listed chest won 6 of 7 plans. 19-00-59: keep-away won when amusing appeared (2:00, 30%) and on the queen's first plan (3:05, 45%). Chests won at 86% and 80% with no boss up, and at 63% at 2:49 with no boss listed. Explore won the opening. The same evade line then lost to explore while the boss was still inside 200.

claim: Planner scores chest lower when far or low hp.
evidence: Prior runs; 18-01-48 opened many mid-game chests at moderate hp. 18-47-09: a chest 91 away scored 65% at 74 hp and won. A chest 299 away scored 41% and lost to explore 58% at 63 hp. At 44 hp the close-enough chest still won at 25%. Distance, more than low hp, is what dropped the score under explore. 19-00-59: a chest 55 away scored 86% at 120 hp; a chest 148 away scored 63% at 103 hp and won, with no boss listed.

claim: Bog Toad dash damage is seed-specific; missing on some long-run seeds.
evidence: Absent 17-20-20 and 18-01-48 outcomes.

claim: Default dash template rarely uses charge; E24 yes-rules spend it often.
evidence: 17-09 18 dashes; 18-01-48 54 dashes per stats.

claim: First chest listing often after ~1:30 at exploreDistance 300; 600 can be earlier on some seeds.
evidence: 18-01-48 XZIVVU first chest 1:43 at 300. E26 1:08 at 600. 18-32-36 IXJBKS first chest 2:04 at 300, hp 62/120, after amusing. 18-47-09 YLS7TB at 300: first chest 2:15, hp 74/120, after amusing. 19-00-59 XEPS03 at 300: first chest 1:44, hp 120/120 on the listing row, two opened by 1:48.

claim: Boss clock: amusing ~2:00, Colorado Queen ~3:00 on world.
evidence: 18-01-48 matches; full boss ladder to 16:01 Grater. 18-32-36 amusing first seen at 2:00. 18-47-09 amusing first seen at 2:00, died before the queen. 19-00-59 XEPS03: amusing first seen at 2:00, Colorado Queen at 3:02.

claim: Under 20% hp, explore beats evade without chest/food when directive set.
evidence: 17-20-20 food at 48/192. 18-01-48 evade then recover at 11:53.

claim: Dash yes-rules spend charge when enemies_near>=5 or hurt>=5 in 3s.
evidence: 54 dashes on 18-01-48; 11:36 mud-golem dash at 60%. 18-32-36: 5 dashes (1:24, 1:56, 2:02, 2:14, 2:19), each with enemies_near at least 5 or a hard hp drop. Early asks at 3–15% stayed walks. 18-47-09: 8 dashes (1:20, 1:31, 1:37, 1:58, 2:12, 2:28, 2:33, 2:39) on the same rule. Asks at 3–8% stayed walks. 19-00-59: 13 dashes, the yeses at 53–84%, and asks at 2–8% stayed walks. From 1:38 to 1:43, about twelve asks with enemies_near 5–9 and no 5 hp drop scored 15–49% and did not dash. The enemies_near clause is not sufficient on its own.

claim: Dash yes can follow move direction and hurt chest approach.
evidence: 1:48 dash on 18-01-48; chest still opened. 18-47-09: dash down at 2:28 (59%) on the chest approach, then enemies_near 21 and -6 hp. The chest never opened.

claim: Amusing can hit hard with forecast priced safe.
evidence: 17-03; absent dmg line some seeds. 18-32-36: free walk at 2:09 lost 2 hp to amusing. The larger ticks (10 at 2:14, 6.7 at death) were on model steps. 18-47-09: a model step at 2:43 lost 18 (34 to 16, amusing 23.3), then the page walked the chest direction for 11 more (16 to 5) with amusing 25 away.

claim: ~30 hp jumps without food can happen after 3:00 and before 3:00 on world.
evidence: B18 disproved only 'none in first 3 min'. 18-47-09: +15 at 1:35 (105 to 120) and +30 at 2:22 (61 to 91), no food goal, max hp 120. 19-00-59 XEPS03: +30 at 1:44 (90 to 120), no food goal, max stayed 120. That was the run's whole heal.

claim: E21 directive + E24 dash can reach 15+ minutes with chest evolutions on some seeds.
evidence: This run 7:06 with same family templates—not 15m but 3x YLS7TB/IXJBKS short deaths; evolution 2:30 and Thousand Fries 6:47 show stack viability.

claim: ice-imp and blight-spore dominate some long crowd runs.
evidence: 18-01-48: blight-spore 617, ice-imp 114 killing blow share.

claim: No dash on standing_on chest charging helps channel complete.
evidence: Multiple runs.

claim: E37 approach dash text does not stop high-probability chest dashes.
evidence: E37 refuted.

claim: Hot oil underfoot during chest channel can kill at low hp.
Hp rises 24-46 with no food goal and no max change on world.
evidence: 17-20-20; Gravy max changes separate. 18-47-09: +30 at 2:22 and +15 at 1:35, max hp stayed 120, no food goal. 19-00-59: +30 at 1:44, 90 to 120, max stayed 120, no food goal.

claim: Wireworm and Mandoline can deal 50-82 hp on forecast-free walks.
evidence: 17-20-20; Mandoline 140 on 18-01-48 outcome.

claim: exploreDistance 600 can list chest before 1:30 at high hp.
evidence: E26 one seed.

claim: Skip over Sack of Gold/Baked Potato at high hp; Baked Potato when lower.
evidence: 17-20-20 pattern.

claim: Planner can pick crit over max HP at shrine with boss within 100.
Under 40%, forbidding whetstone keeps it off goals; above 40% it still loses to explore.
evidence: E43 six listings under 40%. 18-01-48: 69% hp at 7:43 listing; 7:59 whetstone 19% vs explore 21%. 18-32-36: listed from 0:41 at 114/120; plan scores 15% vs explore 59% at 168 up-right (0:43), then 11–13% through 1:33. Never started.

claim: On Z40504 at explore 300, first whetstone listed only after hp under 40%; on XZIVVU first listing was 7:43 at 69% hp.
Food beyond ~210 units loses to explore/evade even under 70% directive.
evidence: 18-45-26: food 177 right at 5:37 with hp 120%, Eat food 15% vs Fight Blight Spore 50%; E53 goal tweak active. 19-00-59: food 260 down-right scored 9% at 32/120 (3:26) against keep-away 49%, and food 341 scored 8% at 25/120 (3:29). Both beyond ~210, both lost, including under 40% health.

claim: action.dash can answer yes when neither 5hp nor 5-enemy rule matches.
sizzle-imp can deal 20+ hp on under-forecast steps.
After mid-game, Beetle Nest can still win the goal vote at full hp even when the opening directive forbids early nests.
distrustSeconds 8 asks the action model for about 8 seconds after each forecast-free hit, and the page still takes that hit.
evidence: 18-32-36 IXJBKS: eight walks (0:13, 0:23, 0:43, 0:56, 1:10, 1:18, 1:46, 2:09), 15 hp, then move rows citing that time for about 8 seconds. Hits inside the window still landed (hot oil 1:24, amusing minute).

claim: A whetstone line that says before any chest, and leaves explore legal, loses to explore even above 40% health.
Hot oil can take about 24 hp in a world opening, including a tick the one-second forecast calls free.
evidence: 18-32-36: hot oil 24 of 106. Free walk at 0:56 lost 2. From 1:24 to 1:26 health fell 95 to 74 while hot oil climbed to 13.3, on model steps. 18-47-09 YLS7TB: hot oil 0. The opening hazard was Spore vent, 18 hp.

claim: A listed chest in the boss's direction wins the goal vote while it is still close (about 90–240 units). The action model then refuses the lethal steps, so the channel never finishes. A chest that has drifted out to about 300 can lose to explore.
evidence: 18-32-36: 2:04 chest 94 up-left at 75% with amusing 64 up-left; dropped at 2:09 (18% vs explore 27%). 2:14 chest 36 down at 67% from 37/120 with amusing 37 down-left; failed at 2:21 at 9 hp. 18-47-09 YLS7TB: chest 91 down-left at 2:15 with amusing 134 down-left, planner 65%, model refused, chest drifted to 299 and lost at 2:20 (41% vs explore 58%). Further chest goals at 2:25, 2:28, 2:35 and 2:40, none opened. Died 2:43. 19-00-59 XEPS03: no chest was listed while a boss was within 200, so the boss-direction half was not retested. The 2:49 chest at 148, with no boss listed, scored 63% and opened.

claim: Some nightmare world seeds never list a chest in the first 3+ minutes at exploreDistance 300; at 600 some still list only after ~3:00 while others never list before death.
evidence: 6BZ2E7 no chest by 3:16; 1AS5RU0 listed 2:04 at 300 after E60 elite pivot and amusing minute.

claim: Before any chest opens, Beetle Nest can win the goal vote over explore at high hp when nest scores high-30s% even if planner.state forbids early charge spots.
evidence: 18-40-20: 2:37 P176 at 106/120 hp, plan nest 39% vs explore 37%; nest done 2:43, first chest open 3:35.

claim: If the directive does not forbid them, Beetle Nest beats explore at full hp (about 50–63%) and the 1.5 second channel completes. A nest also wins while a boss is up, and that channel can cost a chunk of hp at the end.
evidence: 18-47-09 YLS7TB: six nests, all charged and used, at 0:42 (50%), 1:08 (56%), 1:17 (63%), 1:31 (50%), 1:53 (61%) and 2:08 (51%). The 2:08 nest had amusing 242 away and telegraph underfoot, and ended at 2:12 with hp 90 to 77 (field-rat 10.1, amusing 2.2). At 1:53 it beat a Seed Vault already at 0.4 of 2 seconds.

claim: Some nightmare world seeds deal their opening hazard damage as Spore vent, not hot oil. A hot-oil total of zero on those seeds means the oil never appeared.
evidence: 18-47-09 YLS7TB: Spore vent 18, hot oil 0. Windows of 1.9 at 0:51, 7.2 at 1:30 and 9.1 at 2:00. Underfoot was spores, and also chill, slow and telegraph. Brambles 2.3 showed on the 1:07 page walk and is missing from the outcome list.

claim: A hot-oil-only action line is not applied to Spore vent. The model minimizes the one-second forecast and can still be on spores a second later, while the 3-second vent window is larger than that forecast.
evidence: 18-47-09: action text named only hot oil. At 1:28 a no-damage step was chosen and underfoot was still spores, with the vent window at 7.2 by 1:30. At 1:58–1:59 the least-bad steps stayed in the cloud while the window climbed from 1.5 to 9.1. Page walks at 0:51, 1:29 and 1:59 never read the template (distrustSeconds 0).

claim: The line 'Evade only when no chest and no food is listed' does not select evade. Explore wins the opening, and keep-away stays near 20%.
evidence: 18-47-09: 0 evade goals. Explore 16 done and 8 dropped before and during the chest chase. Keep-away was 16–25% on every plan (25% at 2:00 and 2:12 was the high). At 0:00 explore up-right 54% vs keep-away 19%. Food was never listed. The intent's under-40% evade line was not in the template.

claim: When no chest is listed and game time is past 2:00, E60 planner.goal (yes to fight listed elite, no to explore/gems) is enough to start an elite goal without an E54-style elite line in planner.state.
evidence: 1AS5RU0 E60 run: 0 elite goals before 119.4s; Fight Potato Beetle start 1:59 with elites 47-48% on plan at 1:59; first chest 2:04; lived 7:06. YLS7TB with E54 state only had 0 elite goals and no chest open.

claim: A boss-within-200 evade line in planner.state wins the appearance plan and the next few cycles, then explore beats keep-away while the boss is still inside 200.
evidence: 19-00-59 XEPS03. Amusing: keep-away won at 2:00 (30%, boss 182, reason a boss appeared), 2:05 (59%), 2:08 (49%), 2:13 (63%), 2:16 (31%), 2:21 (31%), 2:23 (46%). At 2:24 explore up 36% vs keep-away 27%, amusing 91 left. Explore won again at 2:29 (52 vs 25, boss 137), 2:30 (28 vs 22, boss 156), 2:35 (33 vs 26, boss 83), 2:41 (48 vs 33, boss 116). Queen: keep-away won at 3:05 (45%, boss 125), 3:10 (56%), 3:13 (37%). At 3:18 explore up-right 33% vs keep-away 31%, queen 160, health 76/120.

claim: Colorado Queen's own damage can be absent from the outcome while garden-slug, tomato-leech and sand-crab take the queen minute. Evade with no direction does not leave that swarm.
evidence: 19-00-59 XEPS03. Queen first seen at 3:02. No queen line on the outcome. Minute 3 lost 97 hp, ended 2/120. garden-slug 32, tomato-leech 21, sand-crab 18, of 119 total. The evade from 3:21 to 3:29 lost 48 hp. At 3:21 a step went 73 to 60 with tomato-leech 15.1 and the queen 33 away. Died 3:45 with 173 enemies, 15 within 60.

claim: A directive line that a close Spud Freezer is also good loses to explore.
evidence: 19-00-59 XEPS03, rule 7 of the E59 directive. At 1:08 the Spud Freezer 127 up-left scored 35% and explore up-right 55%. Earlier freezer listings scored 19–27% against explore in the 50s. No freezer goal started.

claim: Taking a new weapon over a passive while one weapon is at 5/8 leaves the next chest with nothing to evolve.
evidence: 19-00-59 XEPS03. At 2:23, Seed Potato 5/8, the pick was Seeker Sprouts 42% over Fertilizer 35% and Tater Tot Pup 13%. The 2:57 chest raised Seed Potato 5/8 to 8/8 and Whisk Vortex 1/8 to 3/8. Outcome: first evolution none. Fertilizer was taken at 2:59, after that chest. Four weapons stayed at 1/8. The log does not name the recipe, so this does not say Fertilizer was the catalyst.
